panel.emptyHint: Create a connection to open a remote terminal.
panel.deleteSharedConfirm: Delete shared host "{{label}}"? It will be removed from ALL projects.
panel.insecureBody_one: {{count}} saved host has its password or private key stored in the clear (written before the OS keychain was required). Edit the host and re-enter it to seal it.
panel.insecureBody_other: {{count}} saved hosts have their password or private key stored in the clear (written before the OS keychain was required). Edit each host and re-enter it to seal it.

dialog.title: SSH connection
dialog.description: Saved on this machine. Secrets are encrypted with the OS keychain.
dialog.agentForwardingWarning: A compromised remote can use your local keys while you're connected. Only enable for hosts you trust.
dialog.sharedWarning: Appears in every project. Editing or deleting it affects all of them.
dialog.publicKeyHint: Add this public key to ~/.ssh/authorized_keys on the server:
dialog.label: Label
dialog.agentHint: Uses the OS SSH agent for authentication.

trust.bodyUnknown: First connection to {{host}}. Verify the fingerprint out-of-band before trusting it.
trust.bodyChanged: The key for {{host}} differs from the one you trusted before. This may be a man-in-the-middle attack. Only continue if you know the host was reinstalled or re-keyed.

sftp.unknownAccount: Unknown user or group — type an existing name or a numeric id.
sftp.chownHint: Changing owner or group usually requires root on the server.

files.zipMissing: The server has no zip/unzip/tar available
files.tooManyFiles: Too many files to transfer at once
files.zipStillRunning: Still running on the server — it is taking longer than the client waits. Refresh the pane in a moment to see the archive.

snippets.title: Snippets
snippets.name: Name
snippets.multilineHint: Each line runs as a separate command (it's run as a shell script).
snippets.secretHint: Use ${secret:NAME} to inject a stored secret (e.g. a git token) — resolved right before running.

secrets.title: Secrets
secrets.valueKeep: Leave blank to keep the current value
secrets.deleteConfirmBody: Snippets that use this secret will stop working.

vault.title: Cloud vault
vault.subtitle: Sync your SSH hosts across devices, end-to-end encrypted. The server only ever sees ciphertext.
vault.upgradeMsg: The encrypted SSH vault is a Pro feature.
vault.passphraseHint: Derives your encryption key on this device. Set up a recovery key — without one, a lost passphrase makes the vault unrecoverable.
vault.recoveryShownOnce: Write this down NOW — it's shown only once and lets you recover the vault if you lose your passphrase. Anyone with it can decrypt your vault.
vault.recoveryActive: Recovery key is set up — keep it somewhere safe.
vault.recoveryHint: Without it AND your passphrase, the vault is unrecoverable.
vault.noRecovery: No recovery key was set up for this vault.
vault.noVault: No vault found yet — unlock once to create it.
vault.workspace: Workspace id (share to join another device)
vault.linkConfirmBody: Joining a workspace resets this project's vault sync bookkeeping and pulls that workspace fresh.

share.title: Share hosts with {{org}}
share.subtitle: Pick exactly what leaves this machine. Credentials stay here unless you tick them — a teammate using their own key only needs the endpoint.
share.keyChangedSkipped_one: {{count}} member will be SKIPPED: their encryption key changed since you pinned it.
share.keyChangedSkipped_other: {{count}} members will be SKIPPED: their encryption keys changed since you pinned them.

vault.teamHint: An admin shares the project's hosts; members pull them. Re-sharing rotates the team key.
vault.noOrgs: You're not in any team yet.
vault.noGrant: No vault access for this team yet — ask an admin to share.
vault.grantUnverified: The team grant failed signature verification — refusing to trust it.
vault.granterKeyChanged: The team's signing key changed since last time. Re-verify with an admin before pulling.
vault.memberKeyChanged: Some members' keys changed and were skipped — re-verify with them before sharing.
